title: Malicious code in marshrunner (PyPI)
description: The marshrunner package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a coordinated malicious campaign involving loader packages that execute code from remote URLs. Although the packages themselves do not contain the payload, they facilitate downloading and executing remote malicious scripts. This campaign is identified as having clear malicious intent, including potential infostealing activities.
aiSummary: The marshrunner package (version 0.1.0) is involved in a campaign distributing loader packages that execute code fetched from remote URLs. These packages do not embed the malicious payload directly but serve as delivery mechanisms for remote malicious scripts. The campaign is coordinated and aims to provide multiple deceptive methods to load malicious code, with an intent consistent with infostealing malware.
aiImpact: Users installing or running marshrunner version 0.1.0 risk executing remote malicious scripts, which could lead to unauthorized code execution and potential data theft or system compromise. The package acts as a loader, enabling attackers to deliver and execute arbitrary malicious payloads from external sources.
